notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Subscribe Interaction Class implementation to the exact official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors. The baseline declaration case verifies lifecycle/FOM boundaries; the focused filesystem-report case verifies that an invalid class appends nothing and an accepted passive subscription appends one successful-void record with InteractionClassHandle type 27 and the type-6 Optional passive subscription indicator. Advisory and interaction delivery matrices, MOM interaction delivery, timestamped interaction, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, bool active = true) = 0
